changes_this_review: Added one seed packet only; other removed items were already absent on arrival.

items.item: Organo Republic curled garden cress, 5 g / 2,150 seeds
items.why: One packet, delivery displayed September 23, 7–11 AM; not purchased. Start small patches in both kits with household paper. Leave remaining seed in the US.
Hand-wet paper and seeds; reuse a household sprayer if available. Robot trigger actuation has not been demonstrated.
Carries water, but this is a wide-mouth container, not a controlled pouring spout. Measure grip and test a removable spout, or reuse a suitable household bottle before ordering a replacement.
Useful for checking voltage, shorts and wire continuity during assembly; not installed on the robot. ANA does not explicitly clear this meter and pointed leads. Borrow or buy at the destination.

Optional for the first crop: the cress creator uses household paper. These pads are smaller than the large tray and currently arrive September 30. Japanese entry treatment of this processed wood-fiber product was not individually confirmed.

Useful for sensor holders, not needed to join the selected snap-fit table. Exact holder bolts still depend on measured fit. Carry only useful fasteners; source bundled hex-key tools in Japan unless ANA confirms.
Additional sensor harness for arm movement. Supplied robot motor cables are not spare sensor leads. Route with joint slack and test I²C reliability over the actual light-sensor cable.
Only proposed to switch moisture-probe power. With that probe deferred and no pump, the relay has no first-build role. Cart presence unchanged.
Secure sensor connections after breadboard tests. Loose headers/terminals need soldering to boards; screw terminals accept the finished wire ends.
Retain cables with slack through moving joints; provide strain relief without blocking a camera or pulling on a sensor.
Insulate exposed soldered wire splices. Not necessary over enclosed screw terminals. Use local heat tools; no new heat gun is required in this cart.

Optional conductivity/contact experiment, not required for paper-grown cress. Does not measure tray water level. Keep out of first build; use human checks of water reserve and paper wetness. Cart presence unchanged.
Use ONE movable upward-facing paddle; two spares. Measure at plant height with the arm out of the light path. Lux is not PAR/PPFD.
Optional temperature/humidity context. If retained, mount one on the robot body or near the table, not on the arm.
Temporary dry bench wiring before soldering; not a durable exposed arm harness.
Connects the ESP32 to the owned powered USB hub. The hub connects to the Mac.
Use one USB sensor controller; two spares. Supplies sensor readings to the Mac independently of robot motor controllers. Verify delivered board pinout and safe supply voltages.

verified_context: After authorized seed addition, approximately 11:05 ET
